newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Danninger EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Danninger EPS view raised.

text.p: --Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Monday it raised its earnings per share estimates on Danninger Medical Technology Inc to $0.16 from $0.15 for 1997 and to $0.30 from $0.24 for 1998.

--It said it increased its revenue forecast on the company as well because Danninger outperformed its spinal implant sales estimates in the 1996 Q4 by more than $500,000 and because it expects a greater contribution from the company's growing international sales effort.
--Rodman's revenue forecast is for $17.7 million in 1997 and $19.8 million in 1998.
